vision.name: Vegito
vision.text:
[Instant] POWER: Use when one of your effects requires you to discard 1 card from your hand during combat. Draw a card and raise your anger 1.
POWER: [Attack] 1: Energy attack.
Your Drills are not discarded when your MP changes levels this turn.
DAMAGE: 2 life cards.
vision.note: edge reads HERO -> MP; Trait badges S, E, F; stage cost printed as '1:' rather than 'costing 1 stage'; F badge confirmed as Fusion by the T_Fusion trait card
